task.title: Reconcile cancelled roadmap code-path lint
task.summary: Adjust roadmap path lint so cancelled or otherwise non-open historic tasks do not surface missing code-path reconciliation warnings after source removal, while open tasks still warn on missing paths.

goal.outcome: The remaining `roadmap-missing-code-path` warning for cancelled TASK-012/TASK-036 stale UI paths is resolved without hiding missing path warnings for active roadmap tasks.
acceptance: Roadmap lint still warns when an open task references a missing code path.
Roadmap lint does not warn when a cancelled/non-open historic task references a path removed by later validated work.
The current graph no longer routes the TASK-012 `src/ui` warning as uncovered reconciliation after refresh.
Regression test covers open-task warning and cancelled-task suppression.
non_goals: Do not rewrite historic cancelled task evidence.
Do not remove path validation for active roadmap work.
Do not suppress missing spec/source validation globally.
verification: targeted TASK-075 roadmap lint smoke test

delta.desired: Lint/reconciliation treats non-open historic task code paths as archived evidence while preserving warnings for active tasks.
delta.current: Graph reconciliation reports `roadmap-missing-code-path` because cancelled TASK-012 still references removed `src/ui`.
delta.closure: Task closes after lint behavior and regression tests pass and graph no longer routes the cancelled TASK-012 missing path warning.
